name: S6-GR1P(0.7-3.6)K-M
description:
0.7K/1K/1.5K/2K/2.5K/3K/3.6K

S6-GR1P(0.7-3.6)K-M series inverter is designed for residential PV plants. The maximum input current per string is 14A, which is compatible with high-efficiency modules and bi-facial modules. Compact and lightweight design, make it easy to install. Fanless design, lower noise, brings you a comfortable living environment. Integrated AFCI function can proactively reduce the risk of fire.

 

Unduh Lembar Data Unduhan Lainnya

 

Solis Mini Series Inverter

Fitur Unggulan

  • Jaringan lemah adaptif
  • Efisiensi maksimal 97,3%
  • Mendukung kontrol ekspor daya
  • Pemantauan Konsumsi Beban 24 jam
  • Rentang tegangan yang luas dan tegangan awal yang rendah
  • Perlindungan AFCI, secara proaktif mengurangi risiko kebakaran
Teknologi Utama
  • EPM: Export power manager
  • HF SWITCH: High switch frequency
  • WiFi/GPRS: Real time monitoring
  • AFCI: DC arc-fault circuit protection
